kelpbiodata

kelpbiodata holds field survey datasets for Nereocystis luetkeana and Macrocystis pyrifera from the Hakai Institute in British Columbia, and reference models fitted to them with the kelpbio package. See the kelpbio documentation for the models and how to use the fits. Sites are identified by code (HAK001, …).

Installation

Install from GitHub:

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("HakaiInstitute/kelpbiodata")

Adding new data to a reference dataset

The data behind each reference fit are exported as data_<sheet>_<source>_<species>, with the columns and column types of kelpbio’s simulated datasets, so new data can be appended with dplyr::bind_rows() and the combined data fitted with the kelpbio function for that model. site and year are factors, and bind to factor or character columns.

new <- data.frame(
  diameter_mm = c(31, 44, 27),
  weight_kg = c(1.2, 3.1, 0.8),
  site = "MyProgramme:Cove",
  year = "2026"
)
data <- dplyr::bind_rows(kelpbiodata::data_weight_hakai_nereo, new)
fit <- kelpbio::kb_fit_weight_nereo(data)

Rows with the same site are the same site: a new year of data at a reference site, under its code, shares its site effect. A prefix, as in "MyProgramme:Cove", keeps new sites apart from the reference sites.

Attribution

The Hakai Institute data in this package were collected in collaboration with the Heiltsuk Integrated Resource Management Department (HIRMD) within Haíɫzaqv (Heiltsuk) territory. Any outputs using these data should credit both the Hakai Institute and HIRMD. To learn more about resource management or conducting research in Haíɫzaqv territory, including on kelp forests, visit hirmd.ca. The statement is also returned by kelpbiodata_attribution().

Citation

If you use kelpbiodata in your work, please cite it and the Hakai Institute data packages its datasets are built from. Use citation() to get formatted citations and BibTeX entries:

citation("kelpbiodata")
#> To cite kelpbiodata in publications, cite the package and the data
#> packages its datasets are built from:
#> 
#>   Dalgarno S (2026). _kelpbiodata: Kelp Biomass Data and Reference

#>   <https://github.com/HakaiInstitute/kelpbiodata>.

#>   kelp canopy productivity data from BC Central Coast." Hakai Institute
